changelog:
Toolkit reference docs relocated to docs/reference/agents/ + README/LICENSE mirror.
- The toolkit's own wayfinding docs (commands.md, system-map.md, customization.md, getting-started.md, concepts/, guides/) moved from docs/reference/ root to docs/reference/agents/ — this now cleanly separates the toolkit's reference material from a project's own reference docs (onboarding.md, glossary.md, links.md), which stay at docs/reference/ root and would otherwise collide once scaffolded.
- docs/reference/agents/ also carries a self-contained mirror of README.md + LICENSE (root originals unchanged — GitHub's landing-page render and license detection both depend on root placement) with relative links rewritten for the new location, so the reference bundle is complete wherever it's scaffolded.

--- v4.96 ---
Secret-scanner enforcement fix + path-drift lint + status dashboard metrics.
- secret-scanner: the PreToolUse hook exited 1 instead of 2, so Write/Edit secret blocks NEVER actually blocked — now exit 2 (hard block); also closed the MultiEdit/NotebookEdit scan gap so all edit surfaces are scanned.
- commit.js: no longer crashes on the first commit into a brand-new repo (unborn HEAD).
- NEW path-drift-lint.js (npm run path:lint): recurring writer/reader path-drift check over template prose + the living plan — legacy .output tokens, flat-handoff literals, unknown compartments vs OUTPUT_PATHS; line-level opt-out via path-lint:keep.
- memory-health: checkMemoryDirectories now checks FTS5 index freshness (same mtime criterion as the session-start self-heal) + memory-inbox backlog (>=10 drafts = stalled promotion loop).
- /prime: cross-branch handoff recall — resolves both the branch-preferred and global-newest handoff (latest --any) + unmerged-branch fallback via git log --all.
- /end + finishing-a-development-branch: handoff prune flat-glob footguns removed.
- /review:status: gate-status (PASS/FAIL) + lines-of-code now surfaced in the text summary and as HTML dashboard boxes.
- Hardening from the v4.95-window sweep: 11 review findings fixed, 158 new QA tests, 2 latent bugs (core coverage 69.5->77.3%).

--- v4.95 ---
Path & security hardening (post-ADR-0006).
- secret-scanner: tightened the dummy-word-prefix placeholder allowlist (suffix cap 23→7) so a short generic high-entropy secret can no longer slip through; named-provider secrets (AWS/Stripe/Anthropic/GitHub/GCP/private keys) were never affected — they bypass the allowlist.
- migrate-output-layout: anchored the tracked-work carve-out's git query to the repo root (:/ magic pathspec) so running the codemod from a subdir can no longer silently disable the carve-out and de-track cited files.
- skill-evolution + pre-compaction-archive: corrected three ADR-0006 path references the migration missed (split-arg path.join evaded the text codemod) — the skill-evolution intake/status and pre-compaction agent-update capture were reading/writing the legacy docs/.output/{agent-updates,skill-evolution} paths. Also made all three readers descend into {YYYY-MM}/ month-bucketed day-files, so the skill-evolution loop and agent-update capture actually find their signals (was silently 0).
- Hardened a date-sensitive memory-decay test (pinned the active-days source) that could flake as the calendar advanced.
